NUTRITION
  CALORIES:
    target: 1600..1800 kcal/day
    deficit: 300..500 kcal/day from maintenance
  MACROS:
    protein: 1.6..2.0 g/kg bodyweight
    carbs: 35..45% total kcal, focus on low GI sources
    fats: 25..30% total kcal, mostly unsaturated
  MEAL STRUCTURE:
    meals_per_day: 3..4
    snacks: 1 optional, protein-based
    carbohydrate_distribution: even across meals, avoid large single carb loads
    pre_workout: small balanced meal 1..2h before training
    post_workout: protein + moderate carb within 1h
  FOOD GUIDELINES:
    - prioritize whole grains, legumes, vegetables, berries, nuts, seeds
    - avoid refined sugars, fruit juices, and high-GI foods
    - include lean proteins (fish, poultry, tofu, eggs, low-fat dairy)
    - use olive oil, avocado, and nuts for healthy fats
    - limit saturated fat and processed foods
    - hydrate: 2..2.5L water/day
    - limit alcohol, avoid sugary drinks
    - monitor blood glucose before and after exercise
    - adjust carbs if hypoglycaemia risk (consult with healthcare provider)
    - maintain consistent meal timing
    - consider dietitian referral for individualisation

SUPPLEMENTS
  - vitamin_d3: 1000 IU/day if deficient
  - omega_3: 1g/day from fish oil or flaxseed oil
  - protein_powder: as needed to meet protein target

NOTES
  - monitor blood glucose regularly, especially with increased activity
  - adjust medication only under medical supervision
  - report any symptoms of hypoglycaemia immediately
  - progress resistance and cardio gradually to avoid injury
  - focus on sustainable habits for long-term glycaemic control and fat loss
